item.title: Indebted Hong Kong developer New World offers shares at 81% discount in US$3.2b cash call
item.description: New World Development will issue 11 new shares for every existing share at an 81.5 per cent discount, exposing shareholders who do not participate to theoretical dilution of 75.3 per cent, as the indebted Hong Kong property developer seeks to raise HK$24.9 billion (US$3.2 billion) in a recapitalisation backed by its controlling Cheng family. item.title: Chinese J-10C fighter spotted carrying modified Russian-origin heavy-strike missile
item.description: New state media footage has surfaced showing for the first time what appears to be a Chinese-modified variant of the Russian-origin Kh-29T air-to-surface missile mounted on a J-10C fighter jet. State broadcaster CCTV’s social media account posted a video on Wednesday featuring Chinese fighters, showing the missile mounted under the 4.5-generation fighter as it took off, according to posts by Chinese military bloggers over the weekend. China originally imported about 2,000 Kh-29T missiles...

item.title: A disastrous Iran war? The US is now a mover and shaker of oil markets
item.description: Many see the US war on Iran as a colossal geopolitical bungle, failing to secure its larger strategic objectives. Yet it has allowed the blundering Trump administration to move into an immensely powerful position – one it seems ready to embrace. With its new-found sway over Venezuela’s oil reserves, degradation of Iranian exports and selective sanctions on Russian oil, Washington has unexpectedly acquired several important levers of the global petroleum trade. item.title: Hong Kong police investigate theft of HK$810,000 in cash, gold jewellery from flat
item.description: A public housing resident in Hong Kong has lost more than HK$800,000 (US$101,960) worth of cash and gold jewellery that disappeared from her flat in Ngau Tau Kok, prompting a police investigation. Police said the 41-year-old woman filed a report at about 11.55am on Sunday after discovering the items were missing from her home in Kwai Fai House, Lower Ngau Tau Kok Estate. item.title: Jordan sentences 3 men to death over deadly church attack
item.description: A Jordanian court on Sunday sentenced three men to death by hanging over a deadly church shooting, as the kingdom’s Christmas celebrations were cancelled in solidarity with the victims’ families. Gunmen killed nine people and wounded 25 others when they stormed a funeral at a Greek Orthodox church in southern Hammoud village, Karak governorate, on October 23.
